method_evidence.claim: DreamFusion introduced Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) to optimize a differentiable 3D representation using a frozen 2D diffusion model.
method_evidence.anchor: DreamFusion~\cite{poole2022dreamfusion}, introduced Score Distillation Sampling (SDS), a method that optimizes a differentiable 3D representation—typically a NeRF—such that its rendered views maintain high likelihood under a frozen 2D diffusion model.

method_evidence.claim: 3DShape2Vecset constructed a 3D VAE to compress 3D shapes into a compact VecSet representation for diffusion models.
method_evidence.anchor: 3DShape2Vecset~\cite{zhang20233dshape2vecset}, which innovatively adopted the processing paradigm of 2D Stable Diffusion and constructed a 3D VAE (Variational Autoencoder) to compress 3D shapes into compact VecSet representation.

method_evidence.claim: MVDream introduces a multi-view diffusion model conditioned on camera poses for text-to-3D generation.
method_evidence.anchor: MVDream~\cite{shimvdream} introduces a multi-view diffusion model conditioned on camera poses, enabling the generation of geometrically consistent MV images from text

method_evidence.claim: LRM aims to learn a universal reconstruction capability from large-scale 3D data to generate 3D representations in a single forward pass.
method_evidence.anchor: Large Reconstruction Model (LRM) approach~\cite{hong2023lrm}. LRM aims to learn a universal reconstruction capability from large-scale 3D data, enabling it to generate 3D representations directly from textual or sparse visual inputs through a single forward pass.
